name: player_reset_underwater_fx_pass3_ui_singleton
description: Player::ResetUnderwaterFxPass3UiSingleton resets the underwater pass-3 HUD singleton back to HudUiElement's base dispatch state for atexit cleanup.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja disassembly at 0x41eb20 loads ECX with g_Player_UnderwaterFxPass3Ui and tail-jumps to HudUiElement::ResetCommonFTable.
The direct callee 0x4b47a0 is accepted and tier S; this wrapper only selects the underwater singleton global.
The native smoke verifies that a singleton using underwater pass-3 dispatch state is reset to the base HudUiElement dispatch state.
vc5_attempt: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 --explain-missing 0x41eb20 reported no VC verification target currently covers this address.
